lina: heads-up: i'm opening a docs PR to replace the old tracehook quickstart with `trace.attach()` and a concise migration guide. will also add a background-worker example and a redirect from the legacy URL. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/430 :wave:

rob: can you paste the new minimal snippet here so i can sanity-check the cost/latency tag behavior in the dashboard?

lina: yep, minimal python sample i'll add: 

```python
from redwood import trace
import os

# attach once at process startup
tracer = trace.attach(api_key=os.environ.get('REDWOOD_KEY'), service='orders', env='prod')

with tracer.span('generate_invoice'):
    call_model_for_invoice()
```

note: docs will emphasize "attach at startup, reuse tracer" for worker processes to avoid double-init and duplicate spans. also using `export REDWOOD_KEY` wording instead of inlining keys.
